# Iru Provider

Development provider for Iru Library Items. Prefer IRU_API_URL and IRU_API_TOKEN environment variables.

The [published preview](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/nicholas-r-king/iru/0.1.0-alpha.1)
predates the current draft safety/compatibility changes. Draft development builds
use an explicitly configured Terraform CLI development override. Selected live
resource/metadata tests have passed, but full field, assignment, enrollment and
device-delivery acceptance is incomplete. See the repository API coverage and
exact commit checks before using a build; a mock pass is not production readiness.

Set `IRU_API_URL` to your HTTPS tenant API origin and `IRU_API_TOKEN` through
your existing secure environment. Explicit configuration takes precedence over
environment values. The token is sensitive; avoid storing it in HCL or tfvars.
Unknown configuration values are rejected before use. Configuration makes no
API request. Only the documented Iru/Kandji tenant host patterns are accepted;
paths, ports, user information, queries, fragments and redirects are refused.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

terraform {
  required_providers {
    iru = {
      source = "nicholas-r-king/iru"
    }
  }
}

# Prefer IRU_API_URL and IRU_API_TOKEN from a secure environment.
# The provider currently requires a local development override.
provider "iru" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer API token; defaults to IRU_API_TOKEN. Prefer the environment and keep credentials out of configuration.
- `api_url` (String) HTTPS tenant API origin; defaults to IRU_API_URL.
